items.title: The impact that AI will have on advertising, according to Sir Martin Sorrell
items.summary: Sir Martin Sorrell — the founder and executive chairman of S4Capital — sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss how Meta's (META) new Muse chatbot and other AI products will impact the advertising space.

items.title: Salesforce Is Cheap. ServiceNow Is Growing Faster. Here’s the Stock I’d Buy.
items.summary: Two AI software giants both reported strong agentic bookings this summer, but they sit at opposite ends of the valuation spectrum. The case for buying the cheaper one is stronger than it looks, and the case against it is equally hard to ignore.

items.title: Is Salesforce (CRM) Cheap After AIforce And Koa Launches?
items.summary: Salesforce, the US software group behind a broad suite of CRM and AI tools, has seen a mixed share price ride in recent years, which raises a simple question for you as an investor: Is the current US$234.02 price adequately backed by the earnings power the company is generating today? Over the past 3 years, Salesforce shares have delivered a 17.1% gain, so anyone buying in now needs to judge whether the underlying earnings profile still matches that kind of performance. items.title: Why Salesforce, ServiceNow and Snowflake All Dropped 4% Within Minutes of a Meta Announcement Monday
items.summary: A single Meta newsroom post sent billions of dollars in enterprise software market cap up in smoke within minutes, and the company that arguably had the least to do with the announcement took the biggest hit of all.

items.title: Meta and ServiceNow Drop 4% as Enterprise Platform Launch Reprices Software; MongoDB Tumbles 19%
items.summary: A single newsroom post from Meta Platforms sent shockwaves through enterprise software in minutes, pulling down companies that had nothing to do with the announcement and one that lost something far more concrete than market confidence.

items.title: Software Stocks Slip as Meta Becomes Competition
items.summary: Software companies just got new competition: Mark Zuckerberg's company is launching a business focused on selling its AI tools to enterprise customers. That's putting shares in the sector under pressure: The S&P 500 Software industry index is down nearly 2%.
